# Experience Caddie

Experience Caddie plans golf and concert weekend packages for groups of golfers who want to combine a round of golf with a live concert.

## What we do
- We match confirmed concert tour dates with nearby public golf courses
- We build weekend itineraries that include tee times, concert tickets, and hotel options
- All packages are tied to real, upcoming tour dates — not hypothetical shows
- Users can search by artist name or city to find upcoming packages
- Packages are bookable directly through official partners (Ticketmaster, GolfNow, Booking.com, etc.)

## Who this is for
- Golf groups planning a weekend trip around a concert
- Bachelor parties and milestone birthday weekends
- Groups of 2–6 wanting a structured, bookable golf + live music experience

## Key pages
- / : Homepage with featured packages and experience builder entry point
- /packages : Full list of current verified, bookable packages
- /experience : Interactive planner — enter an artist or city to generate a custom weekend itinerary
